newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P rates St George's Crusade Trust AAA.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates St George's Crusade Trust AAA.

text.p: Ratings agency Standard & Poors said on Monday it had assigned its AAA rating to the A$500 million of mortgage-backed bonds issued by St George Bank Ltd's Crusade Trust No. 1.
Bankers Trust Australia is the bond issue's lead manager.
Standard and Poors said the rating reflecteD the sound legal structure of the transaction and the insurance provided by Housing Loans Insurance Corporation (HLIC).
HLIC's obligations under the primary insurance policy are guaranteed by the Commonwealth of Australia, S&P said.
The interest rate applicable to the bonds would be a floating rate based on a margin over the 90 bank bill swap rate (BBSW).
